reviews.text: H Electric did a really good job installing a new transformer and replacing a damaged outlet. Quick, courteous, and professional. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Jonathan G.

reviews.text: Great professionalism and customer service! My technician took great care to make sure my EV installation was seamless. He handled the Howard County inspection ( pulling permits and scheduling appointments), cable and cable protection (my EV charger is in front of my home therefore my cabling is underground). And of course, he attached the cabling to my electrical panel/ breaker box . He also installed a hardwired charging station along with the pedestal. His price is reasonable and he works efficiently. …
reviews.author: Crys R.

reviews.text: I'm glad to find H Electrics to work on my condo main panels/breakers and checked electric fireplace. They responded quickly to text message and call. The technician showed up on time. They provided professional great service and reasonable price. I would recommend their services to friends and family. And I will reach out to them again, if I will need help in the near future.
reviews.author: Hieu D.
